latest_news.headline: Israeli strikes kill at least 17 as Israel raises concerns over Hamas disarmament plan
latest_news.summary: AP reports strikes from Saturday night through Sunday killed at least 17 people, including children. Israel told the White House it has serious security concerns and says it will not withdraw before Hamas is verifiably disarmed; the implementation path remains unresolved.

latest_news.headline: Ukrainian deep-strike drones kill at least eight and hit Russian oil and bomber targets
latest_news.summary: AP/AFP reporting says Ukrainian drones killed at least eight people across Russian regions and struck the Saratov refinery, Engels bomber base and a Kaluga oil depot. The reciprocal long-range campaign is intensifying, while the tracker remains at its conventional-war ceiling.
latest_news.source: Associated Press; Agence France-Presse via Al Jazeera

latest_news.headline: Trump cancels threatened Iran strike as mediators outline deal parameters
latest_news.summary: AP reports Trump ordered U.S. forces to hold off on new strikes, saying regional allies had outlined a deal requiring full Hormuz reopening and an end to Iran’s nuclear threat. Israel agreed to try to complete the deal; Iran had not publicly responded, and a prior June deal collapsed.

latest_news.headline: Iran threatens Gulf energy fields if its energy infrastructure is attacked
latest_news.summary: Reuters reports Iran-affiliated Nournews threatened strikes on Saudi and UAE oil fields and Qatari and Israeli gas fields if the U.S. attacks Iranian energy infrastructure. Kuwait also reported intercepting hostile Iranian drones aimed at vital facilities.

latest_news.headline: China stages joint combat-readiness drills around Scarborough Shoal
latest_news.summary: Reuters reports Chinese military and coast-guard air and naval drills around the Philippine-claimed shoal, plus plans for stronger regular patrol and control measures. No collision or armed exchange was reported.

latest_news.headline: Iranian drones target vital facilities in northern Kuwait
latest_news.summary: Kuwait said hostile Iranian drones targeted several vital facilities; a government facility and company property were damaged by impacts or falling debris, with no casualties reported.

latest_news.headline: Israel destroys Hezbollah tunnel network ahead of Rome talks
latest_news.summary: AP reports Israeli forces demolished a tunnel network beneath Beaufort Castle; Lebanon called the operation a negative signal before renewed talks on Israeli withdrawal and Hezbollah disarmament.

latest_news.headline: Ceuta death toll reaches 67 as Spain installs sea barrier
latest_news.summary: AP reports Spain began installing a 500-metre containment barrier after the mass frontier rush. Most of roughly 60,000 entrants returned and new arrivals slowed, supporting the existing falling trend.

latest_news.headline: Houthi pressure reroutes Saudi-linked shipping at Bab el-Mandeb
latest_news.summary: AP reports the Houthis said eight Saudi ships diverted around Africa after a blockade announcement. No verified de-escalatory break was found.

latest_news.headline: Heavy weapons continue to endanger civilians in South Kivu
latest_news.summary: UN reporting says armed drones, artillery and other explosive weapons continue to be used in populated areas despite peace processes; no later step change was verified.

dashboard_trackers.name: IRAN NUCLEAR
dashboard_trackers.notes: Official IAEA/UN and major-wire review found no new verified nuclear threshold in the past 24h. Verification opacity persists, but stale evidence was not re-counted

dashboard_trackers.name: IRAN WAR
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reuters/AP review through 2 Aug finds no public Iranian acceptance of the proposed deal. The threatened U.S. strike remains on hold, but Tehran warns it will retaliate against renewed attacks, Hormuz remains constrained and the Gulf energy-infrastructure threat remains active; raw/coupled risk holds 94/100

dashboard_trackers.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
dashboard_trackers.notes: Israel-Hezbollah ceasefire violations continue. A 2 Aug report said five Lebanese soldiers were wounded in an explosion in the south, but the IDF denied responsibility and attribution remained disputed; no distinct score threshold is added, raw/coupled risk holds 95/100

dashboard_trackers.name: TURKEY-NATO
dashboard_trackers.notes: NATO Ankara Summit material and the past-24h wire sweep produced no direct Türkiye-alliance combat development. Baseline risk is held

dashboard_trackers.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Past-24h AP/Reuters/official review produced no new India-Pakistan interstate combat threshold. Baseline risk is held

dashboard_trackers.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Past-24h regional and wire review found no distinct new cross-border escalation threshold. Existing 46% risk is held

dashboard_trackers.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE
dashboard_trackers.notes: AP/AFP reporting on 2 Aug says Ukrainian long-range drones killed at least eight people across Russian regions and struck the Saratov refinery, Engels bomber base and a Kaluga oil depot. Russia's July missile campaign also hit a record pace and Ukraine reports a critical Patriot-interceptor shortage; conventional-war risk remains capped at 99

dashboard_trackers.name: RUSSIA-NATO
dashboard_trackers.notes: The 30 Jul Russian missile impact in Poland remains the key allied-territory event. NATO/Polish defenses were activated, but the review found no Article 5 invocation or direct NATO-Russia exchange; raw risk remains 70, coupled 80

dashboard_trackers.name: CHINA-TAIWAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Past-24h Taiwan and allied-source review found no new blockade or invasion threshold beyond the already-priced military pressure. Raw 24, coupled 28

dashboard_trackers.name: DPRK
dashboard_trackers.notes: Past-24h KCNA, allied and wire review found no verified nuclear test or major launch threshold. Score holds at 18

dashboard_trackers.name: SUDAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: UN/major-wire review found no de-escalatory break in Sudan’s war or a new threshold beyond the already extreme baseline. Score holds at 94

dashboard_trackers.name: ISRAEL PALESTINE
dashboard_trackers.notes: AP/PBS (2 Aug) reports Israeli strikes killed at least 17 people, including children, while Israel raised serious concerns over the Hamas disarmament framework and said it would not withdraw before verified disarmament. Existing ceasefire_violation, diplomacy_active and diplomacy_refused signals are reinforced; risk stays near ceiling at 98

dashboard_trackers.name: SOUTH SUDAN ABYEI
dashboard_trackers.notes: Past-24h UN and wire review found no distinct Abyei/South Sudan threshold change. Score holds at 19

dashboard_trackers.name: EASTERN DRC
dashboard_trackers.notes: UN reporting continues to describe South Kivu fighting with drones and heavy artillery despite peace agreements. No post-cutoff step change was verified; score holds at 56

dashboard_trackers.name: YEMEN RED SEA
dashboard_trackers.notes: UN and AP (31 Jul-1 Aug) report the Houthi blockade of Saudi-linked shipping and that eight Saudi ships rerouted; attacks on Saudi tankers keep Red Sea/Bab al-Mandab risk at 100

dashboard_trackers.name: MALI SAHEL
dashboard_trackers.notes: Past-24h UN, regional and wire review found no fresh interstate or major-force threshold beyond persistent Sahel conflict. Score holds at 39

dashboard_trackers.name: SOUTH CHINA SEA
dashboard_trackers.notes: Past-24h official and wire review found no new collision or armed clash beyond the already-accounted patrol pressure. Score holds at 35

dashboard_trackers.name: SOMALIA GULF OF ADEN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Maritime and regional-source review found no new piracy or shipping-disruption threshold in the past 24h. Score holds at 28

dashboard_trackers.name: SOUTHERN THAILAND
dashboard_trackers.notes: Past-24h regional-source review found no distinct new attack cluster or deployment threshold. Score holds at 30

dashboard_trackers.name: KUWAIT IRAQ BORDER
dashboard_trackers.notes: AP/PBS (1 Aug) reports another Iranian drone round hit vital facilities, including a government structure in northern Kuwait, without casualties. The existing infrastructure_strike signal is reinforced; score holds at 30 pending penetration, casualties or retaliation

dashboard_trackers.name: IRAQ INTERNAL CONFLICT
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reuters reporting on 29 Jul confirmed U.S./Saudi attacks on Iran-backed groups in Iraq; no distinct post-cutoff widening was verified. Score holds at 40

dashboard_trackers.name: KENYA SOMALIA BORDER
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reuters (29 Jul) confirmed five Kenyan security officers killed near Mandera; the past-24h review found no further verified cross-border step change. Score holds at 25

dashboard_trackers.name: EGYPT MEDITERRANEAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reuters (29-30 Jul) confirmed a drone-caused fire on two gas vessels at Damietta; no new past-24h strike was verified. Score holds at 20

dashboard_trackers.name: SPAIN MOROCCO CEUTA
dashboard_trackers.notes: AP (1 Aug) says the confirmed death toll reached 67 and Spain began installing a 500-metre sea barrier. Most entrants have returned and crossings slowed to a handful; risk holds at 22/elevated with a falling trend

allied_positions.gulf: The threatened fresh U.S. strike remains on hold, but Iran has not publicly accepted the proposed terms. No verified new Gulf energy strike or complete Hormuz closure/reopening threshold was found.
allied_positions.un_iaea: No new verified Iranian nuclear threshold was located. Direct IAEA news/press access returned HTTP 403, so official board-report indexes, UN material and reputable secondary reporting were checked instead; absence was not scored as calm.
allied_positions.israel_lebanon_gaza: Gaza implementation risk worsened: AP reports at least 17 killed and Israel raised serious concerns over the disarmament framework.
